patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient was brought to the emergency department because of sudden, painless loss of vision in her right eye that occurred 30 minutes ago while watching TV. She has a history of coronary artery disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus but has had trouble adhering to her medication regimen.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden, painless loss of vision in the right eye

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Coronary artery disease, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Has difficulty adhering to medication regimen

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden loss of vision in one eye.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Well, I’m a 60-year-old woman with heart disease, high blood pressure, and type 2 diabetes. About 30 minutes ago, while I was watching TV, I suddenly and painlessly lost vision in my right eye.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or the whites of my eyes.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel **morning stiffness**—for example, stiffness in your joints or muscles when you first wake up that improves as you move around?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t really have morning stiffness in my joints or muscles when I wake up—I haven’t noticed anything like that.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt confused or had trouble thinking clearly—I’m pretty oriented and understand what’s going on.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having night sweats—waking up with your clothes or bedding noticeably damp—recently? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had night sweats or woken up with my clothes or bedding noticeably damp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your thigh that feels like it’s within the muscle (not just under the skin)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump or swelling in my thigh, and I don’t feel anything that seems to be within the muscle.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on your arm (for example, along the inner arm where veins are more visible)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusual skin lesions or spots along the veins on my arm, and I don’t think I’ve seen anything different there.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you worked in an environment where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, or working in a foundry or metal workshop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t worked around metal dust or fumes like welding or grinding—nothing like that in my work or home activities.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around your joints (for example, fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips), such as bumps that seem to be part of the bone rather than just soft swelling?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around my joints—no bumps on my fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips that seem part of the bone.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your thigh (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain in my thigh.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience pain or discomfort during sexual intercourse (either at the vaginal opening or deeper inside)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have pain or discomfort during sexual intercourse.”
